For the State : Mr. Naveen Kumar Ganjhu, App
 --------
Order No.03 /Dated: 13th September, 2024

1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned App for the State.
2.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the abovenamed petitioner with prayer to
release on bail in connection with Dhanwar P.S. Case No.303 of 2023 corresponding to Cyber Case
No.26 of 2024 registered under Sections 376, 328 and 385 of I.P.C. and Section 66(E) and 67(A) of
the I.T. Act, pending in the court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II cum Spl. Judge (Cyber
Crime), Giridih.

entities.text:
Additional Sessions Judge-II cum Spl. Judge (Cyber
Crime), Giridih
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3.  The FIR of this case was lodged by the victim herself with these allegations that she was introduced to a man, who was sanctioning the loan, namely, Rajan Thakur and his mother, namely,
Baijanti Devi.
Rajan Thakur, the petitioner had come to her village and on the pretext of having breakfast with her, he had stupefied and raped her.
He also clicked obscene video and made demand of Rs.2 lakhs and, on refusal of the same, he threatened to make the video viral.
4. As per the allegations made in the FIR, the victim was 29 years old married lady.

In this case trial has commenced and the victim was examined as P.W.-1, the father of the victim was examined as P.W.-2 and the mother of the victim was examined as P.W.-3, their deposition statement is annexed Rajan Thakur @ Rajan Kumar Sharma @ Rajan ... vs The State Of Jharkhand .... ....

The victim in her statement has stated that though she lodged the FIR and her statement was recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C.; but she denied the prosecution story and stated that she was neither raped nor any obscene video was clicked nor she was threatened to make the video viral in not making the payment of Rs.2 lakhs.
The father of the victim P.W.-2 and the mother of the victim P.W.-3, both also denied the prosecution story.
5. In view of the above, the bail application of the petitioner is hereby allowed.

Let the petitioner be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-(Rupees Twenty-Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned in aforesaid cases.

(Subhash Chand, J.) Madhav/-
